file.description: The single value file that Fluent Bit will use as a lookup table to determine if the specified lookup_key exists

record.description: The record to add if the lookup_key is found in the specified file.

mode.description: Set the check mode.

print_query_time.description: Print to stdout the elapseed query time for every matched record.

add.description: This parameter is similar to the ADD option in the [modify filter](https://docs.fluentbit.io/manual/pipeline/filters/modify).

ecs_tag_prefix.description: This parameter is similar to the Kube_Tag_Prefix option in the [Kubernetes filter](https://docs.fluentbit.io/manual/pipeline/filters/kubernetes) and performs the same function.

cluster_metadata_only.description: When enabled, the plugin will only attempt to attach cluster metadata values.

ecs_meta_cache_ttl.description: The filter builds a hash table in memory mapping each unique container short ID to its metadata.

key_exists.description: Check if a key with a given name exists in the record.

key_not_exists.description: Check if a key does not exist in the record.

key_val_is_null.description: check that the value of the key is NULL.

key_val_is_not_null.description: check that the value of the key is NOT NULL.

key_val_eq.description: check that the value of the key equals the given value in the configuration.

action.description: action to take when a rule does not match.

result_key.description: specify a key name of matching result.

lookup_key.description: Field name to process

record.description: Defines the KEY LOOKUP_KEY VALUE triplet.

regex.description: Keep records where the content of KEY matches the regular expression.

exclude.description: Exclude records where the content of KEY matches the regular expression.

logical_op.description: Specify a logical operator: AND, OR or legacy (default).

buffer_size.description: Set the buffer size for HTTP client when reading responses from Kubernetes API server.

kube_ca_path.description: Absolute path to scan for certificate files

kube_tag_prefix.description: When the source records comes from Tail input plugin, this option allows to specify what's the prefix used in Tail configuration.

merge_log.description: When enabled, it checks if the log field content is a JSON string map, if so, it append the map fields as part of the log structure.

merge_log_key.description: When Merge_Log is enabled, the filter tries to assume the log field from the incoming message is a JSON string message and make a structured representation of it at the same level of the log field in the map.

merge_log_trim.description: When Merge_Log is enabled, trim (remove possible \n or \r) field values.

merge_parser.description: Optional parser name to specify how to parse the data contained in the log key.

keep_log.description: When Keep_Log is disabled, the log field is removed from the incoming message once it has been successfully merged (Merge_Log must be enabled as well).

tls.verify.description: When enabled, turns on certificate validation when connecting to the Kubernetes API server.

tls.verify_hostname.description: When enabled, turns on hostname validation for certificates

use_journal.description: When enabled, the filter reads logs coming in Journald format.

cache_use_docker_id.description: When enabled, metadata will be fetched from K8s when docker_id is changed.

regex_parser.description: Set an alternative Parser to process record Tag and extract pod_name, namespace_name, container_name and docker_id.

k8s-logging.parser.description: Allow Kubernetes Pods to suggest a pre-defined Parser (read more about it in Kubernetes Annotations section)

k8s-logging.exclude.description: Allow Kubernetes Pods to exclude their logs from the log processor (read more about it in Kubernetes Annotations section).

labels.description: Include Kubernetes pod resource labels in the extra metadata.

annotations.description: Include Kubernetes pod resource annotations in the extra metadata.

kube_meta_preload_cache_dir.description: If set, Kubernetes meta-data can be cached/pre-loaded from files in JSON format in this directory, named as namespace-pod.meta

dummy_meta.description: If set, use dummy-meta data (for test/dev purposes)

dns_retries.description: DNS lookup retries N times until the network start working

dns_wait_time.description: DNS lookup interval between network status checks

use_kubelet.description: this is an optional feature flag to get metadata information from kubelet instead of calling Kube Server API to enhance the log.

use_tag_for_meta.description: When enabled, Kubernetes metadata (e.g., pod_name, container_name, namespace_name etc) will be extracted from the tag itself.

kubelet_port.description: kubelet port using for HTTP request, this only works when Use_Kubelet set to On.

kubelet_host.description: kubelet host using for HTTP request, this only works when Use_Kubelet set to On.

kube_meta_cache_ttl.description: configurable TTL for K8s cached pod metadata.

kube_meta_namespace_cache_ttl.description: configurable TTL for K8s cached namespace metadata.
